title: The Summer Burbn Was Cut Down to Photos, Comments and Likes
conflicts: Launch date: TechCrunch reported 6 October 2010; Systrom told NPR in 2016 it was 10 October; used TechCrunch's contemporary date. Burbn users: Systrom gave 80-90 and 'about 100' in the same interview; story says about a hundred. The 25,000 first-day sign-ups is Systrom's own figure, attributed to him.
notes: Systrom's Quora answer is blocked, so his words are quoted from TechCrunch's November 2010 reproduction. Krieger's 'friends and family' and 'running flat' remarks come from South Park Commons's notes of a 2019 talk and are paraphrased, not quoted. The reflection leans on rest: the filter idea came during a break Systrom took because both were burned out.
